args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-rc35 (test build, built by wowfa2 CI).

Fix: the quest titles in the quest list grew bigger on every redraw, whatever way a slider moved. Cause: the size of a line was computed from the size the line showed at that moment - after our first write that was already our own size, so every redraw multiplied it again. The size system is rebuilt: every size is now computed only from the sliders and the kind of line, never read back from the screen.
- Font size (9 to 20): the addon's own Persian texts (tooltips, spell and talent texts, quest window, spellbook names).
- Quest list and tracker (70 to 200 percent, default 100 = title 13, objective 12): only the Persian lines of the quest list (M) and the tracker. A line wider than its row still shrinks to fit.
- Game texts, English too (70 to 160 percent, default 100 = the game's own size): back again, and now it works with "Persian font in the whole game" on AND off.
- Chat, red alerts and the settings window keep their own sliders.
Old saved values of the list and game sliders are not reused (they start at 100).
Includes rc7 to rc34.

Data from ForeverDB.net
